variant.Supporting text#38:54: Notifications are peripheral messages in digital products that communicate information or feedback to the user. Notifications serve an essential function in product usability, but should be non-intrusive and avoid obscuring the interface. As a general rule, notifications should appear at the top or bottom, or near the corners of the UI.
